changelog: • **Runtime Virtualization Pipeline:** Enhanced instruction stream protection and metadata pipeline orchestration across modern .NET Core / .NET targets
• **Core Engine Interoperability:** Broadened end-to-end multi-layer protection matrix and envelope ciphering compatibility across unified target platforms
• **Environmental Resiliency:** Refined telemetry analysis heuristics to reduce false-positive mitigations across monitored execution contexts
• **Enhanced Anti-Tamper & Analysis Defenses**: Strengthened core protection layers against automated deobfuscation and reverse-engineering frameworks.
• **Improved Code & Resource Cryptography**: Upgraded dynamic data security and runtime payload packing mechanisms.
• **Optimized Execution Pipeline**: Enhanced runtime polymorphism to disrupt static pattern recognition.
• **Execution Flow Alignment:** Resolved an issue where initialization call sequences in entry routines were inadvertently decoupled during binary packing
• **Cross-Framework Runtime Initialization:** Addressed potential bootstrap-phase termination when initializing runtime components on modern CLR hosting environments
• **Native Subsystem Stability:** Fixed intermittent assertion discrepancies during core low-level runtime verification passes
• **Module Bootstrapping**: Fixed an issue with static type constructor initialization under specific runtime environments.
• **Stability & Performance**: General optimizations to ensure 100% application stability and runtime performance.
